rows.label: Agglomeration code
rows.definition: The code of an agglomeration.

rows.label: Treatment plant code
rows.definition: The code of an urban wastewater treatment plant.
rows.notes: UWWTP table; also the code in `groupingInstallation` in the DischargePoint table.

rows.label: Discharge point code
rows.definition: The code of a discharge point.

rows.label: Creation
rows.definition: A new object that does not replace another.

rows.label: No change
rows.definition: The code and location are unchanged.
rows.notes:
The prefilled value in the first reporting. Missing values may be added. Never with
replaced codes.

rows.label: Change
rows.definition: The code is unchanged; other values are updated.
rows.notes: Includes closing and reopening a facility, and an agglomeration absorbing another.

rows.label: Aggregation
rows.definition: A new object formed by merging two or more objects, which it replaces.
rows.notes: New code. Needs the replaced codes.

rows.label: Splitting
rows.definition: A new object formed by splitting one object, which it replaces.
rows.notes: New code. Needs the replaced codes.

rows.label: Deletion
rows.definition: The object no longer exists and is not replaced.
rows.notes: The code is retired, not removed, and is not reused.

rows.label: Reactivation
rows.definition: An object retired with `deletion` is in use again, under its old code.
rows.notes: Not for an object that has been replaced.

rows.label: Projected
rows.definition: The facility is planned or being designed; construction has not started.

rows.label: Under construction
rows.definition: The facility is being built.

rows.label: Functional
rows.definition: The facility is in use.

rows.label: Disused
rows.definition: The facility is not in use but still exists.

rows.label: Decommissioned
rows.definition: The facility has been closed and taken out of service.

rows.label: Article 3(2)
rows.definition:
Extension of the deadline for collecting systems in agglomerations of 1 000 to
1 999 p.e.

rows.label: Article 6(3)
rows.definition:
Extension of the deadline for secondary treatment of discharges from agglomerations
of 1 000 to 1 999 p.e.

rows.label: Article 7(4)
rows.definition:
Extension of the deadline of Article 7(3), point (d), for tertiary treatment in
areas sensitive to eutrophication.

rows.label: Requested
rows.definition: An extension of the deadline is requested under the provision.

rows.label: Not requested
rows.definition: No extension is requested under the provision.
rows.notes:
The other fields of the row stay
empty.

rows.label: Share of agglomerations
rows.definition:
Eligibility is based on the share of the agglomerations concerned meeting the
requirement on 1 January 2025.

rows.label: Share of load
rows.definition:
Eligibility is based on the share of the generated load of the agglomerations
concerned meeting the requirement on 1 January 2025.

rows.label: Technical
rows.definition: Technical reasons justify the extension.

rows.label: Economic
rows.definition: Economic reasons justify the extension.

codelists.caption: Proposed less stringent treatment ground values

rows.label: High mountain
rows.definition: Discharges into high mountain waters above 1 500 m.

rows.label: Deep marine waters, outermost region
rows.definition: Discharges into deep marine waters in less-populated outermost regions.

rows.label: Cold climate
rows.definition: Discharges from agglomerations of 1 000 to 1 999 p.e. in cold climates.

rows.label: Yes
rows.definition: A risk assessment has been carried out in accordance with Article 18.
rows.notes: The date, the identified risks and the summary are then required.

rows.label: Partially
rows.definition: A risk assessment covers only some urban wastewater discharges.

rows.label: No
rows.definition: No risk assessment has been carried out.

rows.label: End of 2033
rows.definition: The planned resources cover the requirements due by the end of 2033.

rows.label: End of 2036
rows.definition: The planned resources cover the requirements due by the end of 2036.

rows.label: End of 2039
rows.definition: The planned resources cover the requirements due by the end of 2039.

rows.label: End of 2045
rows.definition: The planned resources cover the requirements due by the end of 2045.

rows.label: Other
rows.definition: Another period, explained in `contributionPeriodOther`.

rows.label: Compliant (C)
rows.definition: Articles 3 to 8 compliant; Article 18 requirements fulfilled or not applicable.

rows.label: Non-compliant (NC)
rows.definition: Articles 3 to 8 non-compliant; Article 18 requirements fulfilled or not applicable.

rows.label: Pending deadline (PD)
rows.definition: Pending deadline: time remains for submission of the application.

rows.label: Compliant, Article 18 not met (C+A18)
rows.definition: Articles 3 to 8 compliant; more stringent Article 18 requirements not met.

rows.label: Non-compliant, Article 18 not met (NC+A18)
rows.definition: Articles 3 to 8 non-compliant; more stringent Article 18 requirements not met.

rows.label: New collecting systems, 2 000 p.e. and above
rows.definition: New collecting systems in agglomerations of 2 000 p.e. and above.

rows.label: New collecting systems, 1 000 to 1 999 p.e.
rows.definition: New collecting systems in agglomerations of 1 000 to 1 999 p.e.

rows.label: Measures to reduce storm water overflows
rows.definition:
Measures to reduce storm water overflows from collecting systems, so that they meet Part A
of Annex I.

rows.label: Measures for individual systems
rows.definition: Measures for individual systems used where a collecting system is not established.

rows.label: Measures resulting from a management plan
rows.definition: Measures resulting from an integrated urban wastewater management plan.

rows.label: New collecting systems, below 1 000 p.e.
rows.definition:
New collecting systems in agglomerations below 1 000 p.e., on the basis of the risk
assessment.

rows.label: Renew or replace existing collecting systems
rows.definition: Renewal or replacement of existing collecting system infrastructure.

rows.label: New plant, agglomerations of 2 000 p.e. and above
rows.definition: A new treatment plant providing secondary treatment.

rows.label: New plant, agglomerations of 1 000 to 1 999 p.e.
rows.definition: A new treatment plant providing secondary treatment.

rows.label: Upgrade to tertiary treatment (N)
rows.definition: Upgrade to tertiary treatment for nitrogen.

rows.label: Upgrade to tertiary treatment (P)
rows.definition: Upgrade to tertiary treatment for phosphorus.

rows.label: Upgrade to tertiary treatment (N+P)
rows.definition: Upgrade to tertiary treatment for both nitrogen and phosphorus.

rows.label: Upgrade to quaternary treatment
rows.definition: Upgrade to quaternary treatment for micropollutants.

rows.label: Energy neutrality
rows.definition: Measures to meet the renewable energy targets.

rows.label: Secondary treatment, agglomerations below 1 000 p.e.
rows.definition: Applying secondary treatment on the basis of the risk assessment.

rows.label: Tertiary treatment, agglomerations below 10 000 p.e.
rows.definition: Applying tertiary treatment on the basis of the risk assessment.

rows.label: Quaternary treatment, agglomerations below 10 000 p.e.
rows.definition: Applying quaternary treatment on the basis of the risk assessment.

rows.label: Stricter treatment requirements
rows.definition: Applying stricter requirements for treatment on the basis of the risk assessment.

rows.label: Other appropriate measure
rows.definition: Another appropriate measure under Article 18(2). Describe it in `measureText`.

rows.label: Renew or replace existing treatment plants
rows.definition: Renewal or replacement of an existing treatment plant, including capacity increase.

rows.label: National
rows.definition: The measure applies to the whole Member State; no plants or agglomerations are listed.
rows.notes:
Only for the renewal types `renewOrReplaceCollectingSystem` and
`renewOrReplaceTreatmentPlant` (Article 23(1)(c)). The code fields stay empty.

rows.label: Listed plants or agglomerations
rows.definition:
The measure applies to the agglomerations listed in `euAgglomerationCode` and, for a
measure at treatment plants, to the plants listed in `euUWWTPCode`.
rows.notes: `euAgglomerationCode` always filled; `euUWWTPCode` too for plant measures.

rows.label: Planned
rows.definition: The measure is planned and has not started.

rows.label: Ongoing
rows.definition: The measure has started and is not yet completed.

rows.label: Executed
rows.definition: The measure has been completed.

rows.label: Cancelled
rows.definition: The measure has been cancelled.

rows.label: Known
rows.definition: The cost comes from a project, tender or contract.

rows.label: Estimated
rows.definition: The cost is an estimate, including a rough indicative one.

rows.label: High
rows.definition: High priority measure.
rows.notes: Related to the size of the agglomeration and the level of environmental impact.

rows.label: Medium
rows.definition: Medium priority measure.

rows.label: Low
rows.definition: Low priority measure.

rows.label: European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development
rows.definition: Funding under the European Agricultural Fund for Rural Development.

rows.label: European Regional Development Fund
rows.definition: Funding under the European Regional Development Fund.

rows.label: Interreg
rows.definition: Funding under the Interreg programmes.

rows.label: Cohesion Fund
rows.definition: Funding under the Cohesion Fund.

rows.label: Just Transition Fund
rows.definition: Funding under the Just Transition Fund.

rows.label: Recovery and Resilience Facility
rows.definition: Funding under the Recovery and Resilience Facility.

rows.label: Horizon Europe
rows.definition: Funding under Horizon Europe.

rows.label: InvestEU fund
rows.definition: Funding under the InvestEU fund.

rows.label: European Investment Bank
rows.definition: Funding from the European Investment Bank.

rows.label: Other EU funds
rows.definition: Any other Union fund not listed above.

rows.label: Own funds
rows.definition: Funds of the operator, including tariffs, under the polluter-pays or user-pays principle.

rows.label: Producer responsibility
rows.definition: Funding from producer responsibility organisations.

rows.label: National-federal
rows.definition: Funds from the national or federal budget.

rows.label: Regional
rows.definition: Funds from a regional authority.

rows.label: Municipal
rows.definition: Funds from a municipal authority.

rows.label: Other public funds
rows.definition: Public funds from another source.

rows.label: EU fund
rows.definition: Funding from a Union fund.

rows.label: Loan
rows.definition: A loan from a public or private lender.

rows.label: Private funds
rows.definition: Private funding other than a loan.

rows.label: Not identified
rows.definition: The source of this part of the cost is not yet identified.

rows.label: Secured
rows.definition: The money is granted or committed.
rows.notes: Counts towards the financing of the measure.

rows.label: Applied for
rows.definition: An application for the money has been made.

rows.label: Planned
rows.definition: The Member State plans to use this source.

rows.label: Not identified
rows.definition: No source has been identified yet.

rows.label: Euro
rows.definition: Euro.

rows.definition: Danish krone.

rows.definition: Swedish krona.

rows.label: Icelandic krona

rows.label: Agreed financial plan
rows.definition:
Based on financial plans agreed between the Member State and the producer
responsibility organisations during the recognition procedure.

rows.label: Member State estimate
rows.definition: An estimate by the Member State, where agreed financial plans are not yet available.

rows.label: Not available
rows.definition: No estimate of the contribution is available yet.

fields.label: Location
fields.definition: Representative point of the agglomeration, as a single point geometry (a latitude and longitude pair) in ETRS89 (EPSG:4258) or WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), with at least four decimal places ({ref}`sp-location`).

fields.label: INSPIRE local identifier
fields.definition: Local identifier of the same object in a national INSPIRE dataset.

fields.label: INSPIRE namespace
fields.definition: Namespace of that INSPIRE dataset.

fields.label: INSPIRE version identifier
fields.definition: Version of the object in that INSPIRE dataset, where the source uses versions.

fields.label: Code
fields.definition: Code of the agglomeration. A new agglomeration receives a new code; an existing one keeps its code ({ref}`sp-reporting`). A code from the reporting under Directive 91/271/EEC that does not meet the WISE identifier rules is converted ({ref}`sp-code-conversion`).

fields.label: Code scheme
fields.definition: Scheme of `thematicIdIdentifier`. Always `euAgglomerationCode` ({ref}`sp-cl-scheme`).

fields.label: English name
fields.definition: Existing English version of the name, if available. No translation is required.

fields.label: Name
fields.definition: Official name of the agglomeration.

fields.label: Name language
fields.definition: Language of `nameText`.

fields.label: Version start
fields.definition: Date on which this version of the agglomeration was inserted or changed.

fields.label: Version end
fields.definition: Date on which the agglomeration was retired.

fields.label: Predecessors
fields.definition: Codes of the agglomerations this one replaces, given once, in the delivery in which the change happens. Several codes are separated by commas.
fields.condition: Required with `aggregation` and `splitting`, and with `change` for an absorption

fields.label: Predecessors scheme
fields.definition: Scheme of `predecessorsIdentifier`. Always `euAgglomerationCode` ({ref}`sp-cl-scheme`).

fields.label: Evolution type
fields.definition: What is being reported: no change, a new object, a change, a merger, a split or a retirement.

fields.label: Designation start
fields.definition: Date from which the agglomeration is in the scope of the Directive.

fields.label: Designation end
fields.definition: Date on which the agglomeration left the scope of the Directive.
fields.condition: Required when the agglomeration leaves the scope of the Directive

fields.label: Zone type
fields.definition: Type of management zone, from the INSPIRE zone type codelist. The same value for every agglomeration.

fields.label: Link
fields.definition: Web address of a page with more information on the agglomeration, such as a national register.

fields.label: Location
fields.definition: Location of the treatment plant, as a single point geometry (a latitude and longitude pair) in ETRS89 (EPSG:4258) or WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), with at least four decimal places ({ref}`sp-location`).

fields.label: INSPIRE local identifier
fields.definition: Local identifier of the same object in a national INSPIRE dataset.

fields.label: INSPIRE namespace
fields.definition: Namespace of that INSPIRE dataset.

fields.label: INSPIRE version identifier
fields.definition: Version of the object in that INSPIRE dataset, where the source uses versions.

fields.label: Code
fields.definition: Code of the treatment plant. A new plant receives a new code; an existing one keeps its code ({ref}`sp-reporting`). A code from the reporting under Directive 91/271/EEC that does not meet the WISE identifier rules is converted ({ref}`sp-code-conversion`).

fields.label: Code scheme
fields.definition: Scheme of `thematicIdIdentifier`. Always `euUWWTPCode` ({ref}`sp-cl-scheme`).

fields.label: English name
fields.definition: Existing English version of the name, if available. No translation is required.

fields.label: Name
fields.definition: Official name of the treatment plant, or a working name for a proposed plant.

fields.label: Name language
fields.definition: Language of `nameText`.

fields.label: Version start
fields.definition: Date on which this version of the treatment plant was inserted or changed.

fields.label: Version end
fields.definition: Date on which the treatment plant was retired.

fields.label: Predecessors
fields.definition: Codes of the treatment plants this one replaces, given once, in the delivery in which the change happens. Several codes are separated by commas.

fields.label: Predecessors scheme
fields.definition: Scheme of `predecessorsIdentifier`. Always `euUWWTPCode` ({ref}`sp-cl-scheme`).

fields.label: Evolution type
fields.definition: What is being reported: no change, a new object, a change, a merger, a split or a retirement.

fields.label: Condition
fields.definition: Physical state of the plant: proposed, under construction, in use, disused or decommissioned.

fields.label: Valid from
fields.definition: Date from which the treatment plant is in the scope of the Directive.

fields.label: Valid to
fields.definition: Date on which the treatment plant left the scope of the Directive.
fields.condition: Required when the treatment plant leaves the scope of the Directive

fields.label: Link
fields.definition: Web address of a page with more information on the treatment plant.

fields.label: Location
fields.definition: Location of the discharge point, as a single point geometry (a latitude and longitude pair) in ETRS89 (EPSG:4258) or WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), with at least four decimal places ({ref}`sp-location`).

fields.label: INSPIRE local identifier
fields.definition: Local identifier of the same object in a national INSPIRE dataset.
fields.condition: Required if an INSPIRE identifier has been assigned; give with `inspireIdNamespace`

fields.label: INSPIRE namespace
fields.definition: Namespace of that INSPIRE dataset.

fields.label: INSPIRE version identifier
fields.definition: Version of the object in that INSPIRE dataset, where the source uses versions.

fields.label: Code
fields.definition: Code of the discharge point. A new discharge point receives a new code; an existing one keeps its code ({ref}`sp-reporting`).

fields.label: Code scheme
fields.definition: Scheme of `thematicIdIdentifier`. Always `euDischargePointCode` ({ref}`sp-cl-scheme`).

fields.label: English name
fields.definition: Existing English version of the name, if available. No translation is required.

fields.label: Name
fields.definition: Official name of the discharge point, or a descriptive name.

fields.label: Name language
fields.definition: Language of `nameText`.

fields.label: Version start
fields.definition: Date on which this version of the discharge point was inserted or changed.

fields.label: Version end
fields.definition: Date on which the discharge point was retired.

fields.label: Predecessors
fields.definition: Codes of the discharge points this one replaces, given once, in the delivery in which the change happens. Several codes are separated by commas.

fields.label: Predecessors scheme
fields.definition: Scheme of `predecessorsIdentifier`. Always `euDischargePointCode` ({ref}`sp-cl-scheme`).

fields.label: Evolution type
fields.definition: What is being reported: no change, a new object, a change, a merger, a split or a retirement.

fields.label: Condition
fields.definition: Physical state of the discharge point: proposed, under construction, in use, disused or decommissioned.

fields.label: Valid from
fields.definition: Date from which the discharge point is in the scope of the Directive.

fields.label: Valid to
fields.definition: Date on which the discharge point left the scope of the Directive.
fields.condition: Required when the discharge point leaves the scope of the Directive

fields.label: Treatment plant
fields.definition: Code of the treatment plant, or collecting system without treatment, that discharges through this point. It must be an accepted treatment plant in the UWWTP table.

fields.label: Link
fields.definition: Web address of a page with more information on the discharge point.

fields.label: Situation at
fields.definition: Date of the reported situation, for example the date the programme was approved or the date of the decision not to establish one.

fields.label: Programme obligation
fields.definition: Whether the Member State is obliged to provide a national implementation programme.

fields.label: Programme reference
fields.definition: Reference to the national implementation programme in the documents dataset.

fields.label: Prioritisation reference
fields.definition: Reference to the methodology used to prioritise investments.

fields.label: Article 5 management plan reference
fields.definition: Reference to the document listing the Member State's integrated urban wastewater management plans.

fields.label: Risk assessment
fields.definition: Whether a risk assessment of urban wastewater discharges has been carried out in accordance with Article 18.

fields.label: Risk assessment date
fields.definition: Date of issue of the risk assessment.

fields.label: Risks identified
fields.definition: Whether any risks have been identified. Measures under Article 18(2) that address identified risks are reported in {ref}`art23-measure`.

fields.label: Risk summary reference
fields.definition: Reference to the relevant section of the river basin management plan, or to another official summary of the identified risks and adopted measures.

fields.label: Producer responsibility contribution
fields.definition: Estimated financial contribution from producer responsibility organisations, total at national level.
fields.condition: Required unless `producerResponsibilityEstimateBasedOn` = `notAvailable`, and empty if it is

fields.label: Currency
fields.definition: Currency of `producerResponsibilityContribution`, in millions of that currency. Euro area Member States use EUR.

fields.label: Estimate based on
fields.definition: Basis of the estimate, or `notAvailable` where no estimate is available yet.

fields.label: Contribution period
fields.definition: Period or periods by which the planned resources, including the contribution in `producerResponsibilityContribution`, are expected to be sufficient to meet the requirements of the Directive. Select one or more.

fields.label: Other contribution period
fields.definition: Explanation of the period, where `contributionPeriod` includes `other`.

fields.label: Remarks
fields.definition: Other important information on compliance and its assessment.

fields.label: Article 3 compliance, 2 000 p.e. and above
fields.definition: Share of agglomerations of 2 000 p.e. and above that comply with Article 3 (collecting systems).

fields.label: Article 3 compliance, 1 000 to 1 999 p.e.
fields.definition: Estimated share of agglomerations of 1 000 to 1 999 p.e. that comply with Article 3.

fields.label: Article 4 compliance
fields.definition: Whether a system of authorisation and control of individual systems has been introduced in accordance with the Directive.

fields.label: Article 5 management plans
fields.definition: Number of agglomerations of 100 000 p.e. and above that already have an integrated urban wastewater management plan.

fields.label: Article 6 compliance, 2 000 p.e. and above
fields.definition: Share of agglomerations of 2 000 p.e. and above that comply with Article 6 (secondary treatment).

fields.label: Article 6 compliance, 1 000 to 1 999 p.e.
fields.definition: Estimated share of agglomerations of 1 000 to 1 999 p.e. that comply with Article 6.

fields.label: Article 7 compliance
fields.definition: Share of treatment plants of 150 000 p.e. and above that meet the Article 7 tertiary treatment requirements.

fields.label: Article 8 compliance
fields.definition: Share of treatment plants of 150 000 p.e. and above that meet the Article 8 quaternary treatment requirements.

fields.label: Derogation type
fields.definition: The provision under which the deadline may be extended.

fields.label: Derogation status
fields.definition: Whether an extension is requested under the provision.

fields.label: Extended deadline
fields.definition: The year by the end of which the requirement will be met, under the extension.

fields.label: Eligibility criterion
fields.definition: The criterion on which the Member State relies for eligibility: the share of agglomerations or the share of their load.

fields.label: Agglomerations not meeting the requirement
fields.definition: Number of agglomerations concerned not meeting the requirement on 1 January 2025.

fields.label: Agglomerations meeting the requirement
fields.definition: Number of agglomerations concerned meeting the requirement on 1 January 2025.

fields.label: Load not meeting the requirement
fields.definition: Generated load of the agglomerations concerned not meeting the requirement on 1 January 2025.

fields.label: Load meeting the requirement
fields.definition: Generated load of the agglomerations concerned meeting the requirement on 1 January 2025.

fields.label: Reason type
fields.definition: Whether the reasons for the extension are technical, economic or both. Select one or both.

fields.label: Reason reference
fields.definition: Reference to the technical or economic reasons justifying the extension.

fields.label: Investment plan reference
fields.definition: Reference to the plan detailing the investments needed to meet the requirement within the extended deadline.

fields.label: Agglomeration
fields.definition: Code of the agglomeration concerned, as accepted in the {ref}`spatial-points` dataflow.

fields.label: Area concerned
fields.definition: Description of the area within the agglomeration where the deadline cannot be met.

fields.label: Deadline concerned
fields.definition: The deadline or deadlines that cannot be met in the area. Select one or both.

fields.label: Adjusted deadline
fields.definition: The year by the end of which the required infrastructure will be finalised in the area.

fields.label: Justification reference
fields.definition: Reference to the detailed justification.

fields.label: Agglomeration
fields.definition: Code of the agglomeration whose discharges are subject to less stringent treatment, as accepted in the {ref}`spatial-points` dataflow.

fields.label: Ground
fields.definition: The situation of Article 6(4) that applies.

fields.label: Study reference
fields.definition: Reference to the detailed study showing that the discharges do not adversely affect the environment and human health.

groups.caption: Measure fields - measure, type and coverage

fields.label: Measure code
fields.definition: Unique, persistent code of the measure. The same measure keeps the same code in later updates of the programme, so that its progress can be followed. Primary key.

fields.label: Measure name
fields.definition: The original descriptive name of the measure, or an English translation of it.

fields.label: Measure name language
fields.definition: Language of `measureName`, as a code from the ISO 639-2 vocabulary.

fields.label: Measure reference
fields.definition: Place in a document that describes the measure, where there is one.

fields.label: Measure type
fields.definition: Type or types of the measure, by the article of the Directive they implement. Select one or more, as in the draft format. All the types of a measure concern the same kind of object: treatment plants, or agglomerations.

fields.label: Other measure description
fields.definition: Description of another appropriate measure under Article 18(2).

fields.label: Geographical coverage
fields.definition: Whether the measure applies to the whole Member State or to the plants or agglomerations listed in `euUWWTPCode` or `euAgglomerationCode`.

fields.label: Treatment plants
fields.definition: Codes of the treatment plants the measure concerns, as in the spatial points dataflow. Several codes are separated by commas. The identifier scheme is always `euUWWTPCode`.
fields.condition: Required if `geographicalCoverage` = `listedObjects` and the measure types concern treatment plants; empty otherwise. Accepted codes in {ref}`sp-uwwtp`

fields.label: Agglomerations
fields.definition: Codes of the agglomerations the measure concerns, as in the spatial points dataflow. For a measure at treatment plants, the agglomerations those plants serve. Several codes are separated by commas. The identifier scheme is always `euAgglomerationCode`.
fields.condition: Required if `geographicalCoverage` = `listedObjects`, for every measure type; empty otherwise. Accepted codes in {ref}`sp-agglomeration`

fields.label: Prioritisation
fields.definition: Priority of the measure, related to the size of the agglomeration and the level of environmental impact.

fields.label: Implementation status
fields.definition: Whether the measure is planned, ongoing, executed or cancelled. In the first programme most measures are planned or ongoing.

fields.label: Implementation period
fields.definition: Range of years from the year in which the works start, or are expected to start, to the year in which the measure is expected to be completed, both included, for example `[2028,2033]`. For a measure at a treatment plant, the completion year is the year of expected compliance, meaning 12 months of compliant samples. Where the start year is not known, the lower bound is left open: `[,2036]`.

fields.label: Cost status
fields.definition: Whether the capital expenditure of the measure is known or estimated. Applies to the expenditure of all its rows in {ref}`art23-measurefinancing`.

fields.label: Remarks
fields.definition: Any relevant comment on the measure.

fields.label: Measure code
fields.definition: Code of the measure in {ref}`art23-measure`.

fields.label: Funding source
fields.definition: Where the money comes from.

fields.label: European Union fund name
fields.definition: Name of the EU fund.

fields.label: Loan provider
fields.definition: Name of the lender.

fields.label: Funding status
fields.definition: How far the money from this source is secured.

fields.label: Capital expenditure, 1st cycle
fields.definition: Capital expenditure of the measure from this source in the 1st cycle, 2028 to 2033, the same period as the 4th cycle of the Water Framework Directive, without operational or maintenance costs. Expenditure before 2028 is not reported. Corresponds to `totalCapitalExpenditure4thCycle` in the Water Framework Directive.
fields.condition: Required if the `implementationPeriod` of the measure overlaps 2028 to 2033; empty otherwise. This field, `totalCapitalExpenditureAfter1stCycle` or both are more than 0

fields.label: Capital expenditure after the 1st cycle
fields.definition: Capital expenditure of the measure from this source from 2034 until the completion of the measure, without operational or maintenance costs. Covers the 2nd and 3rd cycles together, to 2045.
fields.condition: Required if the `implementationPeriod` of the measure ends after 2033; empty otherwise. This field, `totalCapitalExpenditure1stCycle` or both are more than 0

fields.label: Currency
fields.definition: Currency of the capital expenditure in this row, which is in millions of that currency. Euro area Member States use EUR.
fields.condition: Required if an expenditure is given. {ref}`art23-cl-currency`

fields.label: Plant code
fields.definition: Code of the treatment plant, as in the spatial points dataflow. Primary key. Its identifier scheme is always `euUWWTPCode`, the only one used, so the scheme is not reported.
fields.condition: Accepted code of a treatment plant of the country in {ref}`sp-uwwtp`

fields.label: Status
fields.definition: Status of the plant at the reference year.

fields.label: Expected load
fields.definition: Planned load entering the plant at the expected date of compliance.

fields.label: Expected capacity
fields.definition: Planned organic design capacity of the plant.

fields.label: Remarks
fields.definition: Any relevant comment on the plant.

fields.label: Agglomeration code
fields.definition: Code of the agglomeration, as in the spatial points dataflow. Primary key. Its identifier scheme is always `euAgglomerationCode`, the only one used, so the scheme is not reported.
fields.condition: Accepted code of an agglomeration of the country in {ref}`sp-agglomeration`

fields.label: Status
fields.definition: Status of the agglomeration at the reference year.

fields.label: Expected load
fields.definition: Expected generated load of the agglomeration at the expected date of compliance.

fields.label: Expected load collected
fields.definition: Expected percentage of the generated load collected through collecting systems at the expected date of compliance.

fields.label: Expected load in individual systems
fields.definition: Expected percentage of the generated load addressed through individual systems at the expected date of compliance.

fields.label: Remarks
fields.definition: Any relevant comment on the agglomeration.

fields.label: Title
fields.definition: Title of the delivery.

fields.label: Creator organisation
fields.definition: Name of the organisation that produced the delivery.

fields.label: Creator e-mail address
fields.definition: Contact address of the creator organisation.

fields.label: Description
fields.definition: Free text describing the delivery.

fields.label: Created
fields.definition: Date the delivery was produced.

fields.label: Language
fields.definition: Language or languages of the delivery.

fields.label: Licence
fields.definition: Licence under which the delivery is published.

fields.label: Rights
fields.definition: Statement of the rights held over the delivery.

fields.label: Rights holder
fields.definition: Organisation holding those rights.

fields.label: Licence document
fields.definition: Document stating the licence, where it is not one of the standard licences.

fields.label: Metadata document
fields.definition: Document holding further metadata about the delivery.

fields.label: Reference code
fields.definition: Unique code of the reference. Primary key, cited by the reporting tables.

fields.label: Document code
fields.definition: Document the reference points into, from the {ref}`art23-document` table.

fields.label: Bookmark
fields.definition: Chapter, section, page or bookmark within the document.

fields.label: Subject
fields.definition: What the cited place covers, for example the investment plan for Article 3(2).

fields.label: Document code
fields.definition: Unique code of the document. Primary key, cited by the {ref}`art23-reference` table.

fields.label: Document name
fields.definition: Name of the document.

fields.label: Hyperlink
fields.definition: Web address of the published document.

fields.label: Document file
fields.definition: The document uploaded to Reportnet 3.

fields.label: Name
fields.definition: Name of the person to contact about the report.

fields.label: Institution
fields.definition: Name of the institution the contact person works for.

fields.label: Phone
fields.definition: Contact person's phone number.

fields.label: E-mail
fields.definition: Contact person's e-mail address.

types.definition: A point geometry: a latitude and longitude pair in decimal degrees, as in the WISE spatial data tables.
A date in the format yyyy-mm-dd.
A whole number.
A whole number of 0 or more.
A non-negative number. The unit, where there is one, is in the unit column of the field.
A value in the interval [0, 100].
A Gregorian year.
A range of values, written as in the PostgreSQL range types following ISO 80000-2, for example [2028,2033] for the years 2028 to 2033 included. A bound left empty is open, for example [,2036].
A character string of at most 4 000 characters, UTF-8 encoded.
A character string of at most 100 characters, UTF-8 encoded.
A character string of at most 250 characters, UTF-8 encoded.
Text of at most 254 characters.
A character string of at most 255 characters, UTF-8 encoded.
A character string of at most 1 000 characters, UTF-8 encoded.
An e-mail address, at most 250 characters, validated with a regular expression.
A web address, starting with https:// or http://.
A web address, at most 2 100 characters, validated with a regular expression.
A WISE identifier of at most 42 characters, starting with the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, as defined for the WISE reporting of the Water Framework Directive.
A wiseIdentifier identifying a document of the documents dataset.
A wiseIdentifier identifying a place within a document of the documents dataset, for example a chapter or a bookmark.
A file uploaded to Reportnet 3, at most 100 MB, as pdf, xlsx or docx.
A three-letter language code of the ISO 639-2 vocabulary of the Eionet Data Dictionary (common/iso639-2), for example eng.
A value of the INSPIRE ZoneTypeCode vocabulary. The value for an agglomeration under the Directive is still to be agreed.
